scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.prod: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run start
scripts.prod:build: npm run build -w @fit-analysis/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w server
